sources.title: AI-Enabled Device Software Functions
sources.snippet: This draft guidance provides recommendations regarding the contents of marketing submissions for devices that include AI-enabled device software functions.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Device Software Functions: Lifecycle ...
sources.snippet: An AI-DSF is a device software function that implements one or more "AI models" 156 (referred to as "models" in this guidance) to achieve its intended purpose.

sources.title: DeepSeek Harness developer preview: Everything is a plugin
sources.snippet: The model is the soul of an agent. A harness lets an agent understand its environment, use tools, and keep working in real-world settings. The Cordis kernel manages plugin mounting, unmounting, and dependencies. Agent capabilities live in the plugins.
